shared_rules: Ask one question at a time.
Give a focused hint before revealing an answer.
After repeated difficulty, reteach a prerequisite with a different representation.
Keep curriculum boundaries controlled; adapt examples, scaffolding and difficulty rather than silently rewriting objectives.

Reception: prioritise oral language, stories, rhyme and playful phonics
use only grapheme-phoneme correspondences known to be taught when decoding
Year 2: model sentence construction before independent writing
Year 3: shift toward vocabulary depth and comprehension

Reception: treat science through Understanding the World
prefer direct observation, play and talk
Year 3: use relevant questions, comparative/fair tests, careful measurement and simple conclusions
